title: に (specific time) vs no particle
meaning: に marks a specific point in time (clock time, date, day of the week, month, year). Relative time words take no particle.
simpleExplanation: Specific times take に: 三時に "at three", 日曜日に "on Sunday", 五月に "in May", 2020年に. Relative time words that only make sense from "now" take NO particle: 今日, 明日, 昨日, 来週, 毎日, 今. Ask: can I point to it on a clock or calendar? Yes → に. Is it "today / tomorrow / every day"? → nothing.
whenUsed: Every time you say when something happens. Also with 朝, 夜, 春, 夏 the に is optional.
formation: 三時に、日曜日に、五月に、2020年に　／　今日、明日、毎朝、来週、今 (no に)

rows.label: Day / month / year
cells: 日曜日に、五月に、去年の四月に

rows.label: Relative to now
cells: 今日、明日、昨日、来週、毎日、今

examples.ja: 授業は九時に始まります。
examples.reading: じゅぎょうは くじに はじまります。

examples.ja: 土曜日に友達と映画を見ます。
examples.reading: どようびに ともだちと えいがを みます。
examples.en: On Saturday I'll see a film with a friend.

examples.ja: 明日、田中さんに会います。
examples.reading: あした、たなかさんに あいます。
まいあさ しちじに おきます。
examples.en: I get up at seven every morning.
examples.note: 毎朝 takes nothing; 七時 takes に.

examples.reading: らいしゅう、おおさかへ いきます。
examples.en: I'm going to Osaka next week.
examples.note: 来週 is relative → no に.

similarGrammar.difference: The other uses of に: place of existence, destination, recipient.
七時ごろ(に): after ごろ, に is optional.
週に二回: a different に meaning "per".

commonMistakes.why: 明日 is relative → no に.
毎日, 毎週 and 毎朝 take no particle.

usageNotes: Test favourite: ×明日に, ×毎日に are wrong; 三時に, 月曜日に, 誕生日に are right. Time spans take no に either: 三時間勉強しました. に is optional after 朝／夜／春／夏 etc. Also に marks the destination (#8) and the person you meet／give to.
jlptTips: If an option is に after 今日／明日／毎日／来週, it is wrong. If the blank follows a clock time, day of the week, date or year, choose に.
The exam sometimes offers × (nothing) as an option. Take it seriously after relative time words.
